provenance: AI-authored training-only paraphrases of existing training scenario families. Not independent evaluation data or real customer records.

BB01: My home internet is completely gone. There is a red light marked LOS on the fibre box, even after a restart.
Nothing at home can get online and the optical box is flashing red. Switching it off and on made no difference.
BB02: The broadband is down on everything. Even the computer plugged into the router cannot connect; the screen says authentication failed.
No internet on either Wi-Fi or cable. The fibre lights look fine but the router keeps rejecting the connection login.
BD01: You've taken money from me twice for one bill. Both payments have gone through, neither is pending.
Why am I being charged twice for the same monthly invoice? I can see two completed payments.
BD02: There's an extra entertainment subscription on my bill that I never agreed to. I want the charge checked.
My bill includes a TV add-on I didn't order. Can you look into this unexpected fee?
HW01: My router won't turn on at all. The socket works, I tested it with a lamp, but there are no lights on the box.
The internet box seems dead. I checked the plug and power point and still cannot get it to light up.
HW02: Since that update my router just keeps rebooting. It starts up then switches itself off again.
The modem is stuck in a restart loop after the software update. I already tried switching it off once.
ID01: Whenever it rains my broadband cuts out and comes back. My wired PC does it too, restarting hasn't helped.
My internet connection keeps dropping in wet weather. It happens even with a cable straight into the router.
ID02: My broadband keeps cutting in and out every evening. Both the wired laptop and wireless devices lose the connection.
Every night the internet stops for a bit and then comes back. Ethernet drops too and there aren't any big downloads running.
MC01: I get no mobile signal in my flat but it returns when I step outside. My partner has the same problem on this network.
My phone has hardly any bars indoors. Two phones lose reception here but both work outside the building.
MC02: None of us can get a mobile signal around here today. It isn't just my handset and going outside doesn't help.
My neighbours' phones and mine all lost network coverage at the same time, indoors and outside.
MD01: I can call and text on the new phone but nothing loads on mobile data. Wi-Fi is fine and data is switched on.
Since changing my handset I can't use the internet away from Wi-Fi. Calls still work, and I've restarted already.
MD02: The internet on my phone has become painfully slow after using up most of my data allowance. Calls are fine.
Mobile data was fast earlier in the month and now it's crawling. My usage is close to the plan limit.
NP01: I tried moving my number to you but the transfer was rejected because the account details don't match.
My number port failed. The old operator says the name on the transfer request is different from their records.
NP02: I'm transferring my number tomorrow. The new SIM isn't working yet but my old one still does. Is that why?
My number hasn't switched over. The confirmed porting date is tomorrow and I'm still using the old line.
PR01: I've paid the overdue bill and it shows completed, but my broadband is still cut off for nonpayment.
Can you reconnect my service? The bill is paid and settled in my account but the suspension is still there.
PR02: I paid to get my service back but the bank still says pending. My account says unpaid and I'm still disconnected.
My broadband was suspended. I've made the payment, though it hasn't cleared yet, and the service hasn't come back.
RM01: I'm overseas with a roaming pack. Calls work but I can't use data, and my account shows data roaming disabled.
My roaming package is active but the internet doesn't work abroad. The phone setting is on; the account setting seems off.
RM02: I'm travelling abroad and my phone connects to a local network but mobile internet won't work. Another partner network is listed.
Roaming data isn't working on the foreign network I'm connected to. There is another supported operator available here.
SA01: The replacement SIM won't activate. The number printed on the card isn't the one in my order.
I received a new SIM but it stays inactive. It looks like the card serial doesn't match what was registered.
SA02: My eSIM won't install on this phone because the QR code says already used. I scanned it on the old handset first.
I tried moving my eSIM to another phone but the activation code has already been used. How can I activate it here?
SM01: My bank login texts never arrive. Normal SMS and codes from other services come through fine.
I can't receive the OTP from my bank, but other messages work. Please don't ask me to share the code.
SM02: Texts come in but none of my messages will send. I've tried different numbers and restarted the phone.
I can receive SMS but sending always fails, even to ordinary contacts. It isn't just one recipient.
SP01: I upgraded my broadband to 300 but my wired speed tests still won't go above 100. Downloads are paused.
Why am I still getting my old internet speed after the upgrade? A cable test on a capable computer tops out at 100 Mbps.
SP02: Broadband is really slow on one wired computer but fast on the other. The slow PC says its link is only 100 Mbps.
Downloads crawl on my desktop over Ethernet. Another computer on the same router is much faster.
TV01: Live TV keeps buffering on Wi-Fi. If I plug the set-top box into Ethernet the picture plays normally.
The television stream freezes over wireless but works over a cable to the box. Can you help with the TV connection?
TV02: I paid for new TV channels but they say not authorized. The channels I already had still work.
My new television package hasn't unlocked. Only the newly added channels show an authorization error.
VC01: I can't make any calls from my mobile. People can call me and data works, but every outgoing call fails.
My phone won't dial out to anyone even though incoming calls and the internet still work.
VC02: Mobile calls keep disconnecting when I walk between rooms. They last longer if I stay still and data keeps working.
I keep losing voice calls as I move around the house. The phone's internet stays connected.
WF01: Wi-Fi barely works upstairs but it's fine next to the router. My wired desktop has no problem.
The wireless connection is terrible in the bedroom, though internet over a cable works normally.
WF02: Every evening the Wi-Fi gets really slow, but the computer plugged into Ethernet stays fast at the same time.
Wireless internet slows right down at night in my flat. Wired internet is still quick, so it seems to be just Wi-Fi.
